name: Ohio DOT priority site readiness and workforce access
scope: Published statewide results for 78 Ohio DOT priority development sites identified with JobsOhio. The readiness classes are aggregate site counts.

report.title: Strategic Transportation & Development Analysis Final Report
report.page_convention: One-based PDF pages and printed Chapter 2 page numbers are listed separately.

workforce_access_measures.purpose: Figure showing workforce reach with site readiness classes
workforce_access_measures.definition: Workers reachable in a 40-minute drive under congested travel conditions.

workforce_access_measures.purpose: Labor access input to the multi-factor site readiness score
workforce_access_measures.definition: Projected workers reachable in a 40-minute congested drive.

workforce_access_measures.purpose: Road segments where congestion risks reducing access to workers
workforce_access_measures.definition: Forecast risk to workforce within a 40-minute commute of workplaces.

use_in_a_site_trial: Measure inbound travel to the proposed employee entrance for the actual staffed shift starts.
Hold the workforce estimate, boundary inclusion rule and commute threshold constant while comparing traffic scenarios.
Save candidate area, travel mode, departure or arrival window, route data vintage and whether traffic was observed or forecast.
Carry the regional worker estimate separately from occupation counts, shift availability and recruiting feasibility.
